From e94d6b7f615e6dfbaf9fba7db6011db561461d0c Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Kan Liang <kan.liang@linux.intel.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Mar 2019 11:00:14 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] perf pmu: Fix parser error for uncore event alias

Perf fails to parse uncore event alias, for example:

  # perf stat -e unc_m_clockticks -a --no-merge sleep 1
  event syntax error: 'unc_m_clockticks'
                       \___ parser error

Current code assumes that the event alias is from one specific PMU.

To find the PMU, perf strcmps the PMU name of event alias with the real
PMU name on the system.

However, the uncore event alias may be from multiple PMUs with common
prefix. The PMU name of uncore event alias is the common prefix.

For example, UNC_M_CLOCKTICKS is clock event for iMC, which include 6
PMUs with the same prefix "uncore_imc" on a skylake server.

The real PMU names on the system for iMC are uncore_imc_0 ...
uncore_imc_5.

The strncmp is used to only check the common prefix for uncore event
alias.

With the patch:

  # perf stat -e unc_m_clockticks -a --no-merge sleep 1
  Performance counter stats for 'system wide':

       723,594,722      unc_m_clockticks [uncore_imc_5]
       724,001,954      unc_m_clockticks [uncore_imc_3]
       724,042,655      unc_m_clockticks [uncore_imc_1]
       724,161,001      unc_m_clockticks [uncore_imc_4]
       724,293,713      unc_m_clockticks [uncore_imc_2]
       724,340,901      unc_m_clockticks [uncore_imc_0]

       1.002090060 seconds time elapsed

Signed-off-by: Kan Liang <kan.liang@linux.intel.com>
Acked-by: Jiri Olsa <jolsa@kernel.org>
Cc: Andi Kleen <ak@linux.intel.com>
Cc: Thomas Richter <tmricht@linux.ibm.com>
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Fixes: ea1fa48c055f ("perf stat: Handle different PMU names with common prefix")
Link: http://lkml.kernel.org/r/1552672814-156173-1-git-send-email-kan.liang@linux.intel.com
Signed-off-by: Arnaldo Carvalho de Melo <acme@redhat.com>

diff --git a/tools/perf/util/pmu.c b/tools/perf/util/pmu.c
index 6199a3174ab9..e0429f4ef335 100644
--- a/tools/perf/util/pmu.c
+++ b/tools/perf/util/pmu.c
@@ -732,10 +732,20 @@ static void pmu_add_cpu_aliases(struct list_head *head, struct perf_pmu *pmu)
 
 		if (!is_arm_pmu_core(name)) {
 			pname = pe->pmu ? pe->pmu : "cpu";
+
+			/*
+			 * uncore alias may be from different PMU
+			 * with common prefix
+			 */
+			if (pmu_is_uncore(name) &&
+			    !strncmp(pname, name, strlen(pname)))
+				goto new_alias;
+
 			if (strcmp(pname, name))
 				continue;
 		}
 
+new_alias:
 		/* need type casts to override 'const' */
 		__perf_pmu__new_alias(head, NULL, (char *)pe->name,
 				(char *)pe->desc, (char *)pe->event,
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `tools/perf/util/pmu.c`**
   - **Lines Added**: 
     - A new conditional block was introduced to handle uncore event aliases. This block checks if the PMU is an uncore type and compares the PMU name with the event alias using `strncmp` to allow for common prefixes.
     - The logic for determining if a new alias should be created has been modified to accommodate this new check.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in `pmu.c` addresses a specific bug related to parsing uncore event aliases in the `perf` tool. The original implementation assumed that event aliases corresponded to a single PMU, which led to parsing errors when multiple PMUs shared a common prefix. The new logic allows for the identification of uncore event aliases from multiple PMUs by checking for common prefixes, thus fixing the parser error and enabling correct performance statistics collection for uncore events. This change enhances the flexibility and accuracy of the `perf` tool when dealing with uncore events.

       724,042,655      unc_m_clockticks [uncore_imc_1]

Link: http://lkml.kernel.org/r/1552672814-156173-1-git-send-email-kan.liang@linux.intel.com

Here is the root cause:
The bug arises from the assumption that event aliases correspond to a single PMU, leading to parsing errors when multiple PMUs share a common prefix. The original implementation used `strcmp` to compare PMU names, which fails for uncore event aliases that can originate from different PMUs with the same prefix. This oversight prevents the correct identification of the relevant PMUs for the event aliases.

Here is the patch:
  */
 static void pmu_add_cpu_aliases(struct list_head *head, struct perf_pmu *pmu)
 {
 	int i;
 	struct pmu_events_map *map;
 	struct pmu_event *pe;
 	const char *name = pmu->name;
 	const char *pname;
 
 	map = perf_pmu__find_map(pmu);
 	if (!map)
 		return;
 
 	/*
 	 * Found a matching PMU events table. Create aliases
 	 */
 	i = 0;
 	while (1) {
 
 		pe = &map->table[i++];
 		if (!pe->name) {
 			if (pe->metric_group || pe->metric_name)
 				continue;
 			break;
 		}
 
 		if (!is_arm_pmu_core(name)) {
 			pname = pe->pmu ? pe->pmu : "cpu";
+
+			/*
+			 * uncore alias may be from different PMU
+			 * with common prefix
+			 */
+			if (pmu_is_uncore(name) &&
+			    !strncmp(pname, name, strlen(pname)))
+				goto new_alias;
+
 			if (strcmp(pname, name))
 				continue;
 		}
 
+new_alias:
 		/* need type casts to override 'const' */
 		__perf_pmu__new_alias(head, NULL, (char *)pe->name,
 				(char *)pe->desc, (char *)pe->event,
 				(char *)pe->long_desc, (char *)pe->topic,
 				(char *)pe->unit, (char *)pe->perpkg,
 				(char *)pe->metric_expr,
 				(char *)pe->metric_name);
 	}
 }
